source_instruction: i am looking for tulua apple cider vinegar lemon ginger flavored fruit juice that is certified organic.
query:
I just had the silliest run-in on my walk over to the store, actually! A tiny fluffy golden retriever puppy darted right out from between two parked cars, towing a bright red leash behind it, and I had to scoop it up before it trotted straight into the bike lane. Its owner, a college kid covered in paint splatters from the art department down the block, came sprinting after it two minutes later, huffing so hard he could barely say thank you before he pressed a still-warm chocolate chip cookie he’d been carrying into my palm. I’m still grinning about it, honestly, it’s the kind of tiny, nice surprise that makes a boring errand day feel way brighter.
Hey there, I’m browsing the beverages section right now looking for Tulua apple cider vinegar lemon ginger. I need it to be certified biodynamic, plus it has to come with a free reusable pour spout for the bottle too. Can you show me options that fit? I don’t want to spend too much, so just pull ones that work for my budget, yeah?
